summary: Frontend-only testing for iter 216h102/103 features: Communications Inbox status pill bug fix and CRM Tender Engine v3 features (Win/Loss analytics, Slide Manager, OCR button, Templates dropdown). All features verified working. Fixed missing API prop in SlideManager component.

ocr_button.details: OCR button visible on Documents tab for documents with extracted_chars < 40. Button has correct data-testid pattern [data-testid=ocr-doc-{docId}].

templates_dropdown.details: Template picker dropdown visible in question editor when templates are seeded. Found 9 template options. Dropdown has correct data-testid pattern [data-testid=template-picker-{questionId}].
